authority: Comparator discovery, primary-source/repository binding, licence audit, entrypoint probe, and interface analysis only. No protected outcome was accessed; no scientific superiority claim is authorized.

status_vocabulary.EXECUTED_KEYLESS_FIXTURE: A documented credential-free fixture completed at the pinned revision; fixture output is conformance only.
status_vocabulary.ENTRYPOINT_BOUND_NOT_END_TO_END_EXECUTED: Repository, licence, and documented entrypoint are bound, but provider/data/compute prerequisites prevented a full run.
status_vocabulary.SOURCE_AVAILABLE_RESTRICTED: Source is public but its repository licence is not verified as OSI-open.
status_vocabulary.DATA_OR_BENCHMARK_ONLY: The public repository supplies data/evaluation or a baseline substrate, not the named comparator implementation.
status_vocabulary.CANNOT_CHECK: Identity, licence, code, or executable semantics are absent or ambiguous.

protocol_binding_audit.blocker: The external slot has no exact repo SHA, adapter, model/provider identity, or byte-equivalent interface binding.

P2_TASK_WORLD_SUCCESSOR_V2 requires a CAPABILITY_MATCHED_EXTERNAL_COMPARATOR but names no exact system/revision/adapter. SIEVE is the strongest runnable paper-linked retrieval candidate found here, not yet a frozen arm.
P3_PARTIAL_IDENTIFICATION_SUCCESSOR_V1 gives a count and multiplicity family but no four comparator identities; live ontology/schema systems therefore remain unbound.
The naturalistic successor requires CANNOT_CHECK-capable external comparators but freezes no IDs. No audited candidate below exposes the exact native paired terminal required.
P5_WIDE_REVISION_LEVEL_SUCCESSOR_V1 says six fixed comparators without listing them; SELF_ORION_V3 lists only three and all three remain non-official mechanism bindings.
